findings.location: Paragraph beginning “The interesting thing about that meeting…”
findings.source_quote: “It is true that when a man comes into a vital relationship with Jesus Christ, his supreme desire is to win others.” … “Those young girls were there that night to win their Master, and they won him.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “tamanio lake kuu ni kuwashinda wengine” with “tamanio lake kuu ni kuwaongoza wengine kwa Kristo,” and “nao wakamshinda” with “nao wakamwongoza kwa Kristo.”
findings.translation_quote: “tamanio lake kuu ni kuwashinda wengine.” … “nao wakamshinda.”
